commentary.text: 90+8' Francisco Maeso is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' 3 - 0 Goal! Hugo Duro (Valencia) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Largie Ramazani, then sends the ball into the middle of the net. 3:0.

90+6' The cross into the penalty area from Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.

90+3' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francisco Maeso no option but to blow his whistle. Getafe have a free kick.
90+1' Luis Milla (Getafe) has a huge chance to score from close range, but his effort goes just a few inches wide of the right-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
90+1' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Luis Milla (Getafe) as his effort only hit the wall.
90+1' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for an infringement. Getafe earn a free kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Dani Raba (Valencia), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Luis Rioja as he is replaced by Largie Ramazani (Valencia).
87' Adrian Liso (Getafe) fails to score from inside the box as his rebound smashes against the left post!
87' Coba da Costa (Getafe) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
84' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) for a tough tackle.
83' Substitution. Diego Lopez walks off the pitch and Jose Copete (Valencia) comes on as a substitute.
82' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
82' The ball is out of play. Getafe win a corner kick.
82' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.
81' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
81' Coba da Costa (Getafe) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
80' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
79' Dani Raba (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe have a free kick.

78' What a great chance for Borja Mayoral (Getafe). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
78' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Getafe.
78' Coba da Costa (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Getafe.
75' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
72' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
72' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. Dani Raba (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to Getafe.
70' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' Coba da Costa (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Julen Agirrezabala, who smothers the ball.
67' Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
66' The game is interrupted now, Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
64' Christantus Uche (Getafe) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
63' A substitution has been made. Arnaut Danjuma goes off and Dani Raba (Valencia) comes on.
62' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Javi Guerra will be replaced by Pepelu (Valencia).

62' Javi Guerra (Valencia) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
61' A pass from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
58' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Borja Mayoral (Getafe) replacing Mario Martin.
58' The referee allows time for a substitution. Davinchi will be replaced by Coba da Costa (Getafe).
58' A cross from Davinchi (Getafe) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
57' Christantus Uche (Getafe) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
56' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
54' 2 - 0 Goal! Javi Guerra slips a clever pass through to Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the right side of the goal. 2:0.
53' Getafe fail to score from a corner as Julen Agirrezabala (Valencia) leaps to collect the ball.
53' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Getafe have a corner.
52' Diego Lopez (Valencia) commits a rough foul. Francisco Maeso stops the game and makes a call. Getafe are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
52' Mario Martin (Getafe) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
49' Javi Guerra (Valencia) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
48' Luis Rioja (Valencia) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' Getafe are ruled offside.
47' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) probably handled the ball inside the penalty area. Getafe are awarded the free kick.
47' The attendance is 45449.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Adrian Liso (Getafe) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45+5' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe have a free kick.

45+4' Hugo Duro (Valencia) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Free kick. Getafe will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

44' Hugo Duro (Valencia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
44' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
43' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

43' Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and Valencia manage to earn a corner.
42' Luis Milla (Getafe) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
41' Javi Guerra (Valencia) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francisco Maeso didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

40' A precise low pass is received by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
39' Adrian Liso (Getafe) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
39' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. It's a free kick to Getafe, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
38' A player from Getafe commits a rough challenge. Francisco Maeso blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Valencia will take a free kick near the side line.
37' Christantus Uche (Getafe) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' Valencia keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
30' 1 - 0 Luis Rioja takes over corner duties and expertly finds Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the top right corner. The score is now 1:0.
30' Luis Rioja (Valencia) steps up to send the ball in.
29' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.

29' The game is interrupted. Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Valencia in a dangerous position.
28' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
27' The Valencia players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
21' Diego Rico (Getafe) serves up a nice cross, but Julen Agirrezabala punches the ball away.
20' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
18' Chance! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
17' Hugo Duro (Valencia) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.
16' Dangerous play by Adrian Liso (Getafe). Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Valencia, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
15' Christantus Uche (Getafe) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
15' Christantus Uche (Getafe) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
14' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
13' Diego Lopez (Valencia) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Valencia.
12' Diego Rico (Getafe) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul. Valencia have been awarded a free kick.
10' One of the players from Getafe times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
9' The corner from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is hurriedly cleared.
9' The resulting corner from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is cleared by the opposition's defence. Valencia get a corner.
8' Diego Lopez (Valencia) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Valencia force a corner. They send men into the box.

7' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by David Soria, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
6' A raking crossfield pass from Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
5' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Davinchi (Getafe). There is a free kick near the sideline to Valencia.
5' Valencia concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Getafe get a free kick.
4' Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
3' Christantus Uche (Getafe) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
1' Diego Rico (Getafe) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
